newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $65.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $65.00 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher than late Tuesday.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 12,400 slaughter steers and 4,300 heifers; 106,100 head confirmed for the week to date, which includes 27,900 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
65.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 106,100 Week Ago - 33,600 Year Ago - 21,700
